page.layout: One column of text on one printed page. Running head centred at top, page number at top right. Main text runs in a single column. The short lines are a list of virtues, each on its own line. A centred two-line heading stands between the list and the next section. No marginal notes. Whole page is in black letter.

main_text.l: Milt sein in austheilung der Güter.
Jederman thun, als du wolltest daß man
Ein gute gewonheit an dich nemmen.
Nicht zu vil leichtfertig oder traurig sein.
Nicht zu hart oder lind sein.
Sich nicht zu viel bekümmern umb zeitliche Güter.

page.notes: Whole page is set in black letter, so no black-letter tags are used. Hyphens at line ends are kept as printed: "ver-hengen", "Beschei-denheit". Initial M of the first paragraph is a large letter joined to "ässigkeit". Doubtful: "wolltest" in the printed form "woltest" is read as "wolltest". Signature "D" and catchword "Den" read from the foot of the page.
